       3 const ELLIPSIS = '...';
       4
       5 function truncate(text, n) {
       6   const str = String(text);
       7   if (str.length <= n) return str;
       8   if (n <= ELLIPSIS.length) return ELLIPSIS.slice(0, Math.max(n, 0));
       9   return str.slice(0, n - ELLIPSIS.length) + ELLIPSIS;
      10 }
